description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for compressing and decompressing query plans in Apache Spark, specifically handling Zstandard compression and plan size validation.

classes.name: PlanCompressionUtils
classes.description: Object providing methods to decompress Spark query plans, handling Zstandard compression, size validation, and error handling.

methods.name: decompressPlan
methods.description: Decompresses a plan if it is compressed, parsing the data into the appropriate plan type.

methods.name: getMaxPlanSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum allowed plan size from Spark configuration.

methods.name: decompressBytes
methods.description: Decompresses byte data using the specified compression codec.

methods.name: decompressBytesWithZstd
methods.description: Decompresses byte data using Zstandard codec, with size validation and stream management.
